2125713321319911503.en_summary: SpaceInvestor_D notes $RKLB Electron flight 101 is on the pad for Thursday night. "Night Owls Never Sleep" will put a StriX radar satellite in orbit for Synspective. Window opens at 7:00 pm ET on Nov 26 from Launch Complex 1 in New Zealand. Launch team set a new wet dress rehearsal record of 4 hours and 45 minutes from boot up to complete. It will be Rocket Lab's 14th launch for Synspective, which has 33 more Electron missions booked through 2031. (Quoted from @RocketLab confirming the WDR record and launch window times.)
